children: August J. Troendle, a 10% owner and President & CEO, sold common stock in two transactions on September 23–24, 2026. The reported prices are weighted averages: $628.64 for the 16,083 shares sold on September 23 and $621.33 for the 27,833 shares sold on September 24. The total reported sale amount was $27,403,895. Following the transactions, Troendle directly owns 389,456 shares and indirectly owns 4,733,019 shares through Medpace Investors, LLC.
